list.name: Exchange Listings Scanner
highlights: Default window is 7 days; dedupe is by exchange+url+title (Alpha by alphaId). Noise filter drops campaigns, copy-trade, dividends, funding/leverage tweaks. Use `--all` to see everything.
Bithumb's 5-notice API window means hourly runs are needed so nothing gets missed.
Type classifier is keyword-based (`classify()` in scan.py). Korean: 신규 거래지원/마켓 추가 = listing, 거래지원 종료 = delisting, 거래 유의 = warning (Korean "monitoring tag"), 해제 = warning lifted.
